nodes.label: Growth Referral Loops (friend + owner)
nodes.rationale: Friend loop: offer a warm candidate their own Vesta, slightly reluctant, then follow the onboard skill inline. Owner loop: surface the candidate to the user with real referral money from vesta-cloud-account (half the first month) and let them say go.

nodes.label: Growth Outreach Gate
nodes.rationale: Only people who have genuinely gone back and forth more than once are ever messaged; strangers get at most a user-made introduction. Declined is forever: never pitch the same person twice.

nodes.label: Growth Contact State Line (Vesta: status/touches/pitched)
nodes.rationale: One line per ~/.contacts/<slug>.md with status none|candidate|offered|member|declined, a rough touch count, and last pitch date; candidates found with grep -l over the contacts store.
